text: Assumption: All controllers shall be stopped before the call — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: All controllers shall be stopped before the call — is this correct?
norm: all controllers shall be stopped before the call
assumption: All controllers shall be stopped before the call.
rationale: According to SWS_CANDriver p. 61, the caller must ensure that controllers are not in an invalid state.

original.text: Annahme: Vor dem Aufruf müssen alle Controller gestoppt sein — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Vor dem Aufruf müssen alle Controller gestoppt sein
original.rationale: Der Aufrufer muss laut SWS_CANDriver S. 61 sicherstellen, dass Controller in keinem unzulässigen Zustand sind.
